name: owner-view
description: Follow what agents do without reading code: a plain-English caption under every tool row, /brief-me (done, left, risky, needs you) written from a cache-read fork and shown on its own when you come back from a break, a stage strip (Plan, Build, Review, Test, Ship) with what the change still needs, and the missing step offered as the prompt suggestion.

captions.title: Plain captions on tool rows
captions.description: Shows a short plain-English line under each tool row. Commands no rule knows get one small, capped model call each.

awayMinutes.title: Away after (minutes)
awayMinutes.description: After this many idle minutes, your next prompt opens a 'While you were away' brief.

suggestions.title: Suggest the missing step
suggestions.description: After a turn, offers the step the change still needs (tests, a browser check, a security review) as the prompt box's Tab suggestion.
